headline: Ammon newspaper: From strategic dialogue to investment opportunities – Jordan and Europe toward broader economic partnerships
summary: Investors and business leaders from Jordan and Europe will meet at the Dead Sea on November 18 and 19 to discuss broader economic partnerships and investment opportunities.
why: Investment forums between Jordan and European partners can lead to trade agreements, foreign direct investment and project financing in the Jordanian economy.
